summary: Import thunk for the Winsock socket() function. Forwards (af, type, protocol) unchanged to the __imp_socket import (0x0059E2DC) and returns the resulting SOCKET handle. Called by the networking layer: sub_561BF0, SocketArrayCreate (00562D20), sub_562D90 and CreateUdpBroadcastSocket (00563080).

local_names.af: address family passed through to the socket import
local_names.type: socket type passed through to the socket import
local_names.protocol: protocol passed through to the socket import

operations.description: Forwards (af, type, protocol) unchanged through the __imp_socket import at 0x0059E2DC
Returns the SOCKET handle produced by the imported socket() call
